entries.014b826ed951d373: Founded in 1912 in Nabari, Mie Prefecture, as a maker of farm tools, it is an agricultural machinery manufacturer. Its head office is in Nabari City, Mie Prefecture; as of March 31, 2026, it had 270 employees, and it has one joint venture affiliate in China.
entries.0ff31b2b2475bdd2: It manufactures and sells feed harvesters and soil-preparation implements for dairy and livestock farming, and also processes parts for large bearings from materials supplied by bearing manufacturers, earning fees in a business model that receives payment for the processing.
entries.18028edea3c5cb4f: It features a focused product line of implements for dairy and livestock farming used to harvest pasture grass and feed crops, and it also has bearing processing technology dating back to 1970.

entries.4484529fdebd7f53: This business processes parts for large bearings. It receives raw materials supplied by bearing manufacturers and performs turning of the outer and inner rings of large bearings used in industrial machinery and railway vehicles, turning of rollers, and grinding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥415 million.
entries.5bc1dcc66fb2e343: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,548 million. By business, the Agricultural Machinery Business was ¥6,132 million and the Bearing Business ¥415 million.
entries.5d303d12ab808eeb: About 94% of revenue comes from the Agricultural Machinery Business, and sales are concentrated among three companies: Kubota, Yanmar Agri Co., Ltd. and Nihon New Holland Co., Ltd. In China, a joint venture affiliate handles production and sales, serving as a foothold for expansion into overseas markets.

entries.f673fefba850230c: This business manufactures and sells agricultural implements. Its products include forage harvesters for the dairy and livestock industries, which are used to harvest grass, feed rice, and feed corn, as well as soil-improvement implements, which are used to spread fertilizer and soil conditioners, and snow-removal equipment. Shandong Wuzheng Gaobei Agricultural Machinery Co., Ltd., a Chinese joint venture, is responsible for production and sales in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,132 million.
